rule: A new autopilot page is written only when its title and cluster contain every content token (at least two) of a target in data/search_intelligence/<host>/target_query_set.json, i.e. a query with Search Console impressions in the rolling 28 days. Anything else is held in data/search_intelligence/held_pages.json with its full brief, not marked processed, and the first run after its query is measured publishes it in one of that day's slots.
